items.source: An alternative is to register an instance of com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession with the container by using Spring’s CqlSessionFactoryBean. As compared to instantiating a com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession instance directly, the FactoryBean approach has the added advantage of also providing the container with an ExceptionTranslator implementation that translates Cassandra exceptions to exceptions in Spring’s portable DataAccessException hierarchy. This hierarchy and the use of @Repository is described in Spring’s DAO support features.
items.translation: 另一种方法是使用 Spring 的 CqlSessionFactoryBean 将 com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession 实例注册到容器中。与直接创建 com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession 实例相比，FactoryBean 方法的优势在于它还能向容器提供一个 ExceptionTranslator 实现，该实现能将 Cassandra 异常转换为 Spring 可移植的 DataAccessException 层次结构中的异常。此层次结构以及 @Repository 的使用在 Spring 的 DAO 支持功能 中有所描述。

items.source: Abstract…Configuration classes wire all the necessary beans for using Cassandra from your application. The configuration assumes a single CqlSession and wires it through SessionFactory into the related components such as CqlTemplate. If you want to customize the creation of the CqlSession, then you can provide a SessionBuilderConfigurer function to customize CqlSessionBuilder. This is useful to provide e.g. a Cloud Connection Bundle for Astra.
items.translation: Abstract…Configuration 类会配置所有必要的 Bean，以便您的应用程序使用 Cassandra。 该配置假设存在一个 CqlSession，并通过 SessionFactory 将其连接到相关组件（如 CqlTemplate）。 如果您需要自定义 CqlSession 的创建过程，可以提供 SessionBuilderConfigurer 函数来自定义 CqlSessionBuilder。 这对于提供例如 Astra 的云连接包等场景非常有用。

items.source: Creating configuration classes that register Spring Data for Apache Cassandra components can be an exhausting challenge, so Spring Data for Apache Cassandra comes with a pre-built configuration support class. Classes that extend from AbstractCassandraConfiguration register beans for Spring Data for Apache Cassandra use. AbstractCassandraConfiguration lets you provide various configuration options, such as initial entities, default query options, pooling options, socket options, and many more. AbstractCassandraConfiguration also supports you with schema generation based on initial entities, if any are provided. Extending from AbstractCassandraConfiguration requires you to at least provide the keyspace name by implementing the getKeyspaceName method. The following example shows how to register beans by using AbstractCassandraConfiguration:
items.translation: 创建用于注册 Apache Cassandra 的 Spring Data 组件的配置类可能是一项令人精疲力竭的挑战，因此 Spring Data for Apache Cassandra 提供了预构建的配置支持类。 继承自AbstractCassandraConfiguration的类会注册 Spring Data for Apache Cassandra 所需的 Bean。 AbstractCassandraConfiguration允许您提供多种配置选项，例如初始实体、默认查询选项、连接池选项、套接字选项等。此外，如果提供了初始实体，AbstractCassandraConfiguration还支持基于这些实体生成模式。 继承自AbstractCassandraConfiguration至少需要实现getKeyspaceName方法以提供键空间名称。 以下示例展示了如何使用AbstractCassandraConfiguration注册 Bean：

items.source: While you can use Spring’s traditional <beans/> XML namespace to register an instance of com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession with the container, the XML can be quite verbose, because it is general purpose. XML namespaces are a better alternative to configuring commonly used objects, such as the CqlSession instance. The cassandra namespace let you create a CqlSession instance.
items.translation: 虽然您可以使用 Spring 传统的 `<beans/>` XML 命名空间在容器中注册一个 `com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession` 实例，但由于其通用性，XML 配置可能会相当冗长。对于常用对象（如 `CqlSession` 实例）的配置而言，XML 命名空间是一种更好的替代方案。`cassandra` 命名空间允许您创建 `CqlSession` 实例。

items.source: Using CassandraTemplate with object mapping and repository support requires a CassandraTemplate, CassandraMappingContext, CassandraConverter, and enabling repository support.
items.translation: 使用带有对象映射和仓库支持的 CassandraTemplate 需要配置 CassandraTemplate、CassandraMappingContext、CassandraConverter，并启用仓库支持。

items.source: To externalize connection properties, you should first create a properties file that contains the information needed to connect to Cassandra. contactpoints and keyspace are the required fields.
items.translation: 要将连接属性外部化，您首先需要创建一个包含连接到 Cassandra 所需信息的属性文件。其中，`contactpoints` 和 `keyspace` 是必需字段。

items.source: One of the first tasks when using Apache Cassandra with Spring is to create a com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession object by using the Spring IoC container. You can do so either by using Java-based bean metadata or by using XML-based bean metadata. These are discussed in the following sections.
items.translation: 在使用 Apache Cassandra 与 Spring 集成时，首要任务之一是通过 Spring IoC 容器创建 com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession 对象。 您可以通过基于 Java 的 Bean 元数据或基于 XML 的 Bean 元数据来实现这一目标。 相关内容将在以下章节中讨论。

items.source:
While the preceding example shows how easy it is to configure Spring to connect to Cassandra, there are many other options.
Basically, any option available with the DataStax Java Driver is also available in the Spring Data for Apache Cassandra configuration.
This includes but is not limited to authentication, load-balancing policies, retry policies, and pooling options.
All of the Spring Data for Apache Cassandra method names and XML elements are named exactly (or as close as possible) like the configuration options on the driver so that mapping any existing driver configuration should be straight forward.
The following example shows how to configure Spring Data components by using XML
items.translation:
虽然前面的示例展示了将 Spring 配置为连接 Cassandra 是多么简单，但实际上还有其他多种选项。  
基本上，DataStax Java Driver 中可用的任何选项也都在 Spring Data for Apache Cassandra 的配置中可用。  
这包括但不限于身份验证、负载均衡策略、重试策略和池化选项。  
Spring Data for Apache Cassandra 的所有方法名称和 XML 元素都与驱动程序中的配置选项完全一致（或尽可能接近），因此映射任何现有的驱动程序配置都应该是直截了当的。
